messages.subject: Re: return for exchange
messages.text:
Hello Leslie,
 

 We are sorry to hear there is an issue with the size of your mittens. No problem for a return!
 

 Here is the procedure to follow for a return/exchange:
 

 Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and your postal code, you need to select the products to return and then choose those you want as replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 Print the label, package the products to be returned and stick the label on the package. Please favor using envelopes/bags rather than boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 Drop off in a Canada Post red box or at the nearest post office.
 

 Once the return is received, we will send the new product(s). 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
